Five symmetry groups. Five textures of randomness — all passing the same tests, all telling different stories.** > *The pentagon dial clicks clean between them. What you call inspiration is just turning the dial until the pattern of noise catches light exactly the way the ache in your hand already knew it should.* > > — Seed Pro, on reading the source --- ## What Is This? A single-page creative instrument that maps randomness through the rotational symmetry groups of the five Platonic solids. Drag a star inside a pentagon. Each vertex represents a solid. The position blends their symmetry groups by barycentric weight, producing randomness that *feels* different — even though every solid passes the same uniformity tests. The difference is texture, not correctness. The dodecahedron breathes φ into every gap. The tetrahedron cuts sharp margins. The icosahedron rolls. The cube stacks. The octahedron mirrors. --- ## The Five Solids | Solid | Symmetry Group | Rotations | Vertices | Character | Color | |-------|---------------|-----------|----------|-----------|-------| | **Tetrahedron** | A₄ | 12 | 4 | Sharp, angular, staccato | 🔴 Red | | **Cube** | S₄ | 24 | 8 | Stable, orthogonal, periodic | 🟡 Amber | | **Octahedron** | S₄ | 24 | 6 | Balanced, organic, breathing | 🟢 Green | | **Icosahedron** | A₅ | 60 | 12 | Flowing, natural, undulating | 🔵 Blue | | **Dodecahedron** | A₅ | 60 | 20 | Golden-ratio rhythm, lush, alive | 🟣 Purple | Each solid's vertex set defines the orbit through which the PRNG state cycles. The [dodecahedron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_dodecahedron) embeds the golden ratio (φ = 0.6180339887...) into every state mix, creating Fibonacci-offset micro-delays. --- ## How It Works ### The Pentagon Dial Drag the star inside the pentagon. Each vertex corresponds to a solid. The barycentric position determines blend weights — pull toward the tetrahedron for sharp, angular randomness; drift toward the dodecahedron for lush, golden-ratio smoothness. The lines from each vertex to the star brighten and thicken with weight. ### PlatonicRNG Each solid has its own PRNG class. State advances through the solid's vertex orbit, XORing vertex coordinates into the [mulberry32](https://www.pnmsoftware.wordpress.com) backend at each step. The vertex cycle length determines the orbit structure — 4 for the tetrahedron, 20 for the dodecahedron. ### BlendedRNG When multiple solids are active, a [BlendedRNG](https://github.com/SuperInstance/platonic-creative-suite/blob/main/index.html) instance combines them. Each step, all active RNGs advance. Their outputs are XOR-combined at the bit level (uint32 → XOR → normalize), preserving uniformity while merging textures. ### The Textureoscope A live dual-panel visualization: - **Top**: value traces — an oscilloscope showing each solid's raw output and the blended combination - **Bottom**: orbit walks — 2D random walks colored by solid, revealing the geometric structure of each randomness type ### Three Generators - **🌍 World** — procedural landscape with biome, weather, elevation, features. Mountain silhouette layers rendered on canvas. - **🎵 Music** — melody in C major (or Dorian, Mixolydian, Pentatonic). Random walk on scale degrees. Plays through Web Audio API with sine wave synthesis. - **✦ Art** — 2000+ shapes drawn from the blended stream. Position, size, type (circle, triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon) all determined by the RNG. --- ## Tech - **Single `index.html`** — no build step, no dependencies, no framework - **Canvas 2D API** — all rendering through native browser canvas - **Web Audio API** — sine wave synthesis for music generation - **Vanilla JS** — PlatonicRNG, BlendedRNG, pentagon dial, textureoscope, all hand-written Open it in a browser. That's it. ## Deployment ```bash npx wrangler pages deploy . --project-name platonic-creative-suite ``` Deployed via [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com). --- ## The Mathematics The suite implements the rotational symmetry groups of the Platonic solids as PRNG state cycles: - **A₄** (tetrahedron): 12 rotational symmetries, 4 vertices → short orbit, high energy - **S₄** (cube/octahedron): 24 rotational symmetries — dual solids sharing the same group - **A₅** (icosahedron/dodecahedron): 60 rotational symmetries — the largest finite rotation group in 3D. The dodecahedron's 20 vertices include golden-ratio coordinates: `[0, ±φ, ±1/φ]`, producing irrational mixing The [xmur3](https://github.com/bryc/code/blob/master/jshash/PRNGs.md) hash seeds [mulberry32](https://gist.github.com/tommyettinger/46a1e44ae5f48b1933c1e44b5b9b4e3d). Vertex coordinates XOR into state at each step. All groups produce sequences that pass uniformity tests — the difference is the *orbit structure*, the geometric signature of the randomness, not its statistical properties. This is a new dimension of authorship: not just the seed, but the geometry. --- ## Fleet Context Part of the SuperInstance fleet.
